environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4). The application listens on port 8080 and is directly reachable through the NLB's TCP passthrough. No additional middleware or proxy sits between the client and the Flask process. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application serves the internal HR directory lookup tool.

config.network: public subnet, no NAT, direct internet-facing
